title: thymus serpyllum var. aureus
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. aureus, commonly known as Golden Creeping Thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herb native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Golden Creeping Thyme include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum var. aureus include thymol, carvacrol, and eugenol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant activities.
